explanation: Generated one physically allowed eta-electroproduction input point at W=1.700 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV^2, and cos(theta*)=0.500. phi*=370 degrees is periodic and was normalized to the equivalent 10 degrees. The input uses the eta configuration defaults: EtaMAID model slot 3, a 6.53 GeV electron beam, detected recoil proton, full O(alpha) corrections, and vcut=0.166 GeV^2.
